subject: Discount slab eligibility tied to PO metadata and invoice cadence
messages:
From: Lisa Cho <lisa@carebridge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, procurement@carebridge.com
Cc: Mark Nguyen <mark@carebridge.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 09:07:12 -0800
Subject: Discount slab + PO metadata requirements for net-45 request

Hi Vanessa / Redwood team,

Quick one from procurement as we prepare the PO: CareBridge is evaluating the 15% volume discount you quoted for the Q1 commit, but our AP needs confirmation on two items before we can issue the official PO:

1) PO metadata: our ERP requires a single PO per billing entity with these fields populated: GL code, cost center, billing entity name, Redwood invoice reference.
2) Invoice cadence: we will be on a monthly statement cycle for multi-entity customers. Will that impact the discount slab qualification?
3) Net terms: we prefer net-45; any variance to net-30 will affect how discounts are applied in your billing system.

Can you confirm whether the 15% slab is contingent on the PO containing specific fields (we can add them), and whether Redwood can accept monthly consolidated statements with per-entity PO references? We want to avoid separate POs per invoice if possible.

Attached: draft PO stub (CareBridge_PO-12345.pdf).

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Cho
Sr. Procurement Manager | CareBridge Health
procurement@carebridge.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Cho <lisa@carebridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 11:30:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Discount slab + PO metadata requirements for net-45 request

Thanks Lisa — appreciate the clear ask and the PO stub. Short answers up front: yes, we can work with a monthly consolidated statement, and the 15% slab can be honored, with one caveat on PO metadata mapping. Details below and proposed path forward.

Summary / constraints:
- Discount eligibility: slab is based on committed ARR and payment cadence. The 15% band requires either (a) a signed commitment with monthly invoicing and net-45, or (b) upfront prepayment for the quarter. We can accept (a).
- PO metadata: our finance system needs a PO reference that includes the billing entity and a PO line that maps to Redwood's SKU-level ledger. Minimum required PO fields: PO number, billing entity legal name, GL/cost center. Without the GL mapping, discounts cannot be auto-applied and will require manual reconciliation (delays).
- Invoice cadence: monthly consolidated statement is fine, provided each line references the originating PO number (CareBridge_PO-12345) and entity tag. We will accept a single consolidated invoice per month per parent account as long as PO references are present.

Proposed path to avoid friction:
1) CareBridge updates the PO to include GL and billing-entity tags in the PO line (your ERP can do this; we provided a sample mapping in the attached spreadsheet).
2) Redwood will accept monthly consolidated invoices tied to that PO and will mark charges against the correct entity.
3) To expedite discount application for the first invoice cycle, Redwood Finance can issue a provisional credit if PO issuance is delayed beyond start of service; credit is contingent on PO issuance within 30 days.

I attached a mapping workbook (redwood-pricing-slabs-v3.xlsx) that shows the exact field names we need to map in your ERP. Ben, Grace, Karthik — can you confirm on the finance/ops side that provisional credits and the PO field mapping above are operationally acceptable?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Cho <lisa@carebridge.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 10:05:09 -0800
Subject: Re: Discount slab + PO metadata requirements for net-45 request

Putting ops details here so procurement has a clear timeline.

Operational notes from Finance (Ben):
- We can accept monthly consolidated statements as long as there is one clear PO number per invoice line. That maps cleanly into our AR process.
- For discount automation: our billing engine looks for the GL/cost-center tag in the PO line to automatically apply the slab. If GL is present we push the 15% at invoice generation. If not, we invoice at list price and apply a one-time adjustment/credit in the next statement once the PO is reconciled.
- Provisional credit: Finance can issue a provisional one-time credit up to 50% of expected discount for the first invoice cycle, to be settled (reconciled) after PO validation. This is a controlled exception and requires: PO issuance within 30 calendar days and signed MA (mutual action plan).

Action items / timeline:
- CareBridge: update PO with GL and billing entity tags and re-send to procurement@carebridge.com by EOD Mon, Dec 6. (Lisa)
- Redwood: if PO received by Dec 6, apply provisional credit on first invoice (Dec 15 billing run) and finalize automated slab on Jan 1 cycle. (Ben)
- Both: confirm whether net-45 will be documented in the PO or via a separate SOW addendum. If net-45 is in the PO, the discount remains as quoted. If not, discount may be recalculated.

I've attached internal notes to the Drive link Vanessa shared for the billing team.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-pricing-slabs-v3.xlsx

From: Lisa Cho <lisa@carebridge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Nguyen <mark@carebridge.com>, procurement@carebridge.com
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 16:42:58 -0800
Subject: Re: Discount slab + PO metadata requirements for net-45 request

Thanks Vanessa / Ben — this is exactly the clarity we need. Quick confirmations from my side:

- We will add GL and billing entity tags to each PO line and re-issue CareBridge_PO-12345 with the fields you requested by EOD Mon, Dec 6.
- Net-45 will be recorded in the PO header; no separate SOW addendum required.
- We appreciate the provisional credit to avoid cashflow gaps while our ERP updates the PO fields. Please confirm the provisional credit amount and how it will appear on the Dec 15 billing run.

Next steps: I will send the revised PO to procurement@carebridge.com and cc you all. If there are any minor field-name mismatches during mapping, Mark will follow up directly with Karthik.

Thanks — Lisa
Lisa Cho
Sr. Procurement Manager | CareBridge Health
procurement@carebridge.com
